look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_04.mp3, 51.5 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone. Logo slots: plain cream cards that hold perfectly still in the foreground, for Sathya to lay official logos over in their editor.

scenes.name: 94 pages
scenes.desc: A page stamped a giant pink 94 while pages riffle past; then the S-1 document stack: one AI company's IPO filing.

scenes.name: Anthropic files
scenes.desc: A still logo slot (Anthropic) over 'S-1 filed Oct 26, 2026'; a B&W trading clip with a pink chart line breaking down: AI financing, shaky.

scenes.name: Popping?
scenes.desc: A soap bubble inflates while a pin creeps up and stops just short: is the bubble popping? Here's the loop.

scenes.name: The loop
scenes.desc: Loop diagram, arrows drawing as each step is named: Nvidia (logo slot) invests in a startup, it buys GPUs (chip clip), borrows against them (collateral), banks lend on steady rental income.

scenes.name: One thing
scenes.desc: A padlock and chain land on a data centre: one demand source; then a data clip: constant demand for those chips.

scenes.name: Pull back
scenes.desc: The loop ring spins down as the bank drifts away: fewer loans, fewer chips bought.

scenes.name: −$80.7B
scenes.desc: Logo slot (Anthropic), then a split board: −$80.7B reported H1 2026 net loss above, ~$72.4B of it non-cash accounting below.

scenes.name: Too simple
scenes.desc: A rubber stamp leaves +$974M Q2 2026 operating income; a pin hits the bubble and bends: too simple.

scenes.name: Save this
scenes.desc: Cheaper tokens with a slashed price tag; Save this, a hand pointing down; not financial advice.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
